summary: Extend marketing config with optional ai_discoverability (engines, prompt_set path, run_cap) and point claim_review_policy.source_of_product_truth at SPEC.md (#1164).
migration_impact: Adopters who customized marketing.yml should merge the new ai_discoverability block and update source_of_product_truth from CURRENT.md to SPEC.md when refreshing from payload.
migration_guidance: Set claim_review_policy.source_of_product_truth to SPEC.md (CURRENT.md is deprecated for product truth).
Add the ai_discoverability block under claim_review_policy when enabling Epic #1159 visibility checks; keep enabled: false until engines and caps are chosen.
Point prompt_set at your prompt-set file (template default: docs/marketing/ai-discoverability/prompt-set.md once #1161 lands).
agent_notes: Honest tactics only: visibility prompts and public claims must trace to SPEC.md or an issue. Do not add a separate ai_discoverability config file — everything lives in .agentic/marketing.yml.
